run_mako_plugin: run the mako_plugin function to validate filegroups, libs, and targets in a build dictionary
check_attributes_function: call check_attributes to validate a single entity against allowed attributes for its kind
create_validator_anything: use the anything function to create a validator that accepts any value without error
create_validator_one_of: use the one_of function to create a validator that restricts values to a specific set
create_validator_subset_of: use the subset_of function to create a validator that checks if all elements are in an allowed set
